Name: Buy Animals Fully Mature and Ready to Produce Products
Author: CodeKokeshi
Description:
[center][b]DISCLAIMER[/b]: I've only tested this in VANILLA STARDEW so please don't expect everything to work with OVERHAUL MODS :D

Purchased barn/coop animals are instantly fully matured and ready to produce.

In other words they will not start as chicks.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DZ2SmGi.png[/img]﻿

___________________________________________________________________________________________________________

[b]Disclaimer:[/b]Please report any issues with a detailed description in the comments or bug section. I am a total beginner to Stardew Valley and its modding scene. [b]When I created this mod, my in-game progress was Spring 21, Year 1. [/b]This mod was long made before the first uploaded mods, I just upload it later for testing purposes.
_______________________________________________________________________[/center]
